items.name: Ravi Kumar
items.quote: Our split AC stopped cooling in peak summer. The technician found a gas leak at the flare joint, fixed it and explained everything before refilling. Cooling has been perfect since.

items.name: Priya Reddy
items.quote: We have an AMC for the office cassette units. Visits happen on schedule and we get a short report each time. No more surprise breakdowns.

items.name: Suresh Naidu
items.quote: They installed two new splits in our flat with neat concealed piping. Clean work, fair quote and no hidden charges.

items.name: Ayesha Khan
items.quote: Needed a compressor for an older unit that other shops couldn't match. They had the right model and fitted it the same week.

items.name: Kiran Rao
items.quote: The deep cleaning made a real difference. The bad smell is gone and the AC cools the room much faster now.

items.name: Mohammed Imran
items.quote: Quick response when our shop's ductable unit tripped. They traced it to a failed capacitor and had it running again within hours.
